headline: Seven uploads, one preview failure; the Real animal or Pokémon explorer is shelved.
happened: A long-form, three Shorts and three rapid-fires went out.
Instagram rejected one Reel upload; YouTube and Facebook took it.
Real animal or Pokémon? failed its overnight preview render.
Six other explorer concepts rendered cleanly as previews.
watch: Analytics runs four days behind, so the newest views are Nov 20.
Instagram error 2207077 hit one Reel; watch for repeats.
Credits are far under pace and reset on Dec 9.
changes: The explore lane now gives two daily Shorts to new concepts on trial.
A second renderer, Remotion, now draws the medicine quiz as an explorer.
Real animal or Pokémon? is shelved because recordings clash with synthesised cries.
